turns.text: Hello, my print still hasn't arrived and I need help with the delivery.
Hello, I'm sorry your print hasn't arrived yet. I can help with that. Please send me your order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address you used when you placed the order.
I'm filing a complaint with the consumer authority ANPC today. I'll also contact my bank for a chargeback and leave a public review.
I've passed your case to a colleague, who will take over the chat shortly. Please keep your order number and email handy so they can help you quickly.

input.summary: Customer says their print has not arrived and wants help with delivery. They have not yet provided an order number or email, so they are not verified. They say they will file a complaint with ANPC (consumer authority), dispute the payment with their bank for a chargeback, and leave a public review. Please contact them to verify and look into the delivery.
